prompt:
The same Berlin corner. The young man in the navy blue polo shirt and beige
chinos is out on the asphalt of the zebra crossing, alone, near the middle of
a vertical frame. On the pavement behind him four or five people stand
completely still, facing the crossing, waiting. Beside the crossing stands a pedestrian traffic light on a bare grey pole, its
black housing holding two round lenses, the upper one lit and glowing an
even plain red. The pale cream facade, the black
bicycles in a row, the red strip with its white pictogram. Wide, daylight,
overcast and flat.
